title: How to Win Friends and Influence People

questions.q: What is the simplest way to make a good first impression?
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a smile is the easiest action for making others instantly like you.

questions.q: Why does smiling help you as well as the other person?
a: It creates positive feelings in you
It makes people owe you a favor
questions.why: Lesson 1 says smiling consciously produces positive feelings by accident.

questions.q: How can you be interesting without talking much?
a: Give full attention and let them discuss themselves
Tell as many of your own stories as possible
Ask no questions and listen in silence
questions.why: Lesson 2 says people love those who listen while they talk about their own lives.

questions.q: What did Teddy Roosevelt do before meeting someone?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says Roosevelt looked people up beforehand so he could raise their favorite subjects.

questions.q: What is the Socratic method used for here?
a: Small yeses before the big yes
Asking questions no one can answer
questions.why: Lesson 3 says each yes makes the next one more likely through consistency bias.
